milestone: Vertical kit grows to 10 packages: three engineering checks shipped end to end in one session

dsh-bug-report-check.decides: bug-report bookkeeping: one-line title, environment, numbered repro steps, expected vs actual
dsh-bug-report-check.distinct_rule: a narrative description without numbered steps is reported as repro-missing — prose cannot be replayed; expected and actual are separate errors so the message names which half is missing

dsh-api-doc-check.decides: API-doc bookkeeping: method+path endpoints, examples, auth model, error shape
dsh-api-doc-check.distinct_rule: a bare path without a verb is not an endpoint — it cannot be called; the error message says so explicitly

dsh-test-report-check.decides: test-report bookkeeping: passed+failed+skipped=total with the arithmetic printed, environment, failure detail
dsh-test-report-check.distinct_rule: the sum check prints the equation and both sides when it fails; a non-zero failure count with no failure section is an error, not a warning

quality_bar: 62 tests across the kit (17 new), audit 10/10 clean, site 11 pages with verbatim CLI output, npm READMEs carry the injected example blocks

distribution.npm: 0.1.0 live for all three (registry dist-tags verified)

bug_notes: the honest tests caught one real source bug before publication: reproSteps rejected numbered steps with a space after the delimiter (1. 打开页面) because the pattern required a non-space character immediately after the dot
